definitions.explanation: Swelling caused by excess fluid trapped in body tissues, common in legs, ankles, or face.

examples.japanese: {足|あし}のむくみが{気|き}になる。
examples.english: I'm concerned about the swelling in my legs.

examples.japanese: {夕方|ゆうがた}になると{顔|かお}がむくむ。
examples.english: My face gets puffy in the evening.

examples.japanese: むくみを{解消|かいしょう}するためにマッサージをする。
examples.english: I massage to reduce the swelling.

notes:
RELATED VERB:
むくむ - to swell, to become puffy

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
・むくみが{出|で}る - to develop swelling
・むくみを{取|と}る - to reduce swelling
・むくみを{解消|かいしょう}する - to relieve swelling

CAUSES:
・{塩分|えんぶん}の{摂|と}り{過|す}ぎ - excess salt intake
・{立|た}ちっぱなし - standing for long periods
・{運動|うんどう}{不足|ぶそく} - lack of exercise
・{妊娠|にんしん} - pregnancy

RELATED PHYSICAL SENSATIONS:
・{痺|しび}れ - numbness
・かゆみ - itchiness
・{凝|こ}り - stiffness
